name: Bond of Flora, Greater (Floral)
body:
Your connection to green growing things blossoms, granting you a host of new organic abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Bond of Flora, character level 9th

Benefit(s): Your connection to plant magic reaches new heights as verdant energy courses through your largely changed form. You can cast goodberry three times a day and barkskin and tree shape once a day each as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level. When casting goodberry this way, you do not need to provide the berries—they bloom ready to eat from flowers that sprout up across your shoulders and upper arms.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
